items.title: Sonny Rollins — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Johnny Griffin says, “I don’t need lyrics. I play notes.”

ctx.x: Yes, sort of the story. Exactly.

It’s funny, we were, I mentioned that we were with Jimmy Heath the other night, and he recounts a story of talking with Ben Webster and Johnny Griffin. And Ben wants to know the lyrics of these songs, because he wants to speak them through his horn.
